title: Affine-local acyclicity is inherited by open restriction
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring of universe $u+1$, let $X,Z$ be schemes of universe $u$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $i:Z\to X$ be a morphism, and let $J$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Write $K(p,F)$ for the underlying abelian sheaf of the module inverse image $p^*F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $H^q(F)$ for Sheaf.H [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Suppose that for every affine open $T\subseteq X$ and every $q>0$, $H^q(K(\operatorname{pr}_1:T\times_XZ\to T,J|_T))$ is subsingleton. Then for every open $W\subseteq X$, every affine open $O\subseteq W$, and every $q>0$, $H^q(K(\operatorname{pr}_1:O\times_W(W\times_XZ)\to O,(J|_W)|_O))$ is subsingleton. No separatedness, closed-immersion, injectivity, or torsion hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Proof, Mayer--Vietoris induction, with the affine vanishing supplied explicitly; coefficient and inverse-image identifications from Tag 03D3

proof.text: Apply IsAffineOpen.image_of_isOpenImmersion to W.ι and the affine open O. Put T = W.ι image O and use hlocal to obtain subsingleton cohomology over T.

Use W.ι.isoImage O, pullback.map with isomorphism vertical maps, and pullbackRightPullbackFstIso to construct e from the iterated fibre product to T ×_X Z. The projection of e to X equals the iterated projection by the projection identities of those isomorphisms.

Compose four upperStarComp isomorphisms (mapping two of them through inverse-image functors) using the equality of projections to X. This identifies e.hom inverse image of the module sheaf over T ×_X Z with the iterated module inverse image of J.

Apply pullback_forget_modules_iso to e.hom and the module sheaf over T ×_X Z. Compose its inverse with sheafCompose.mapIso on the module-sheaf isomorphism. Apply Sheaf.functorH.mapIso, convert with Iso.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv, and compose with cohomologyEquiv along e.hom. The inverse of the resulting additive equivalence is injective, which transports subsingletonness.

lean.statement:
theorem Etale.affine_local_acyclic_open_restriction
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (J : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hlocal : ∀ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → ∀ (q : ℕ), 0 < q →
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.H
        ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((pullback.fst W.ι i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
            ((W.ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj J))) q))
    (W : X.Opens) :
    ∀ (O : W.toScheme.Opens), IsAffineOpen O → ∀ (q : ℕ), 0 < q →
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.H
        ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((pullback.fst O.ι (pullback.fst W.ι i))^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
            ((O.ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
              ((W.ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj J)))) q)
